brief.goal: Create a synthetic service OS package with deterministic contracts and recovery evidence.
constraints: Synthetic fixtures only; no providers or services enrolled.
Research is a fixture, not independently verified knowledge.
non_goals: Deploying to a client or publishing the package

criteria.description: The actual deterministic tests pass, including invalid input fixtures.
A separate reviewer reports contract and boundary findings.
Synthetic artifact recovery is rehearsed without accounts or deployment.

tasks.goal: Implement the smallest testable package and test its contracts.
Review the completed package independently and record findings.
Prepare and rehearse recovery of the synthetic deliverable.
